Coin types appear here once the catalogue data arrives.

Each card is a coin type (one design). The photo shows one example of it, usually from a museum; individual coins vary in strike, centring and wear.

Photos stay with their owners: cards show small credited copies and the full photos load from the owners' websites; credits and licences are on each coin's record. Type data from Nomisma.org and the American Numismatic Society's OCRE, CRRO, PELLA, SCO and PCO (Open Database License), IRIS, Corpus Nummorum and Iron Age Coins in Britain. Histories are written for this catalogue.

This is a catalogue of designs, not an authentication; ancient gold is often forged. Prices are a rough guide from past auction results, buyer's fees included, not valuations. It doesn't sell anything and isn't affiliated with any museum, dealer or auction house.

Logo: Athena on a gold stater of Alexander the Great, c. 328–320 BC, Münzkabinett, Staatliche Museen zu Berlin (Public Domain Mark).
